translations.idiomatic: His son Tongjie was deputy commissioner; during mourning he on his own took provisional affairs and heavily bribed neighboring commands to seek succession; the court knew and for a full year did not inquire.

sentences.zh: 屬昭湣晏駕，文宗即位，同捷冀易世之後，稍行恩貸，即令母弟同誌、同巽入朝，令掌書記崔長奉表，備達懇誠，請從朝旨。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong died and Emperor Wenzong acceded, Tongjie hoped that after a change of reign there would be gradual leniency; he sent his younger brothers Tongzhi and Tongxun to court and had his secretary Cui Chang submit a memorial fully expressing earnest sincerity and asking to follow court orders.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingzong died and Wenzong acceded, Tongjie hoped for gradual leniency after a change of reign; he sent his younger brothers Tongzhi and Tongxun to court and had secretary Cui Chang submit a memorial expressing earnest sincerity and asking to follow court orders.

sentences.zh: 詔授同捷檢校左散騎常侍、兗州刺史、兗海節度使；

translations.literal: An edict appointed Tongjie acting left regular attendant, governor of Yan prefecture, and military governor of Yanhai;
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Tongjie acting left regular attendant, Yanzhou governor, and Yanhai governor;

sentences.zh: 以天平節度使烏重胤為滄州節度以代之。

translations.literal: Tianping military governor Wu Chongyin was made military governor of Cang prefecture to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Tianping governor Wu Chongyin was made Cangzhou governor to replace him.

sentences.zh: 詔下，同捷托以三軍乞留，拒命。

translations.literal: When the edict was issued, Tongjie pleaded on behalf of the three armies to remain and defied orders.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict was issued, Tongjie pleaded on behalf of the three armies to remain and defied orders.

sentences.zh: 乃命烏重胤率鄆、齊兵加討。

translations.literal: Wu Chongyin was then ordered to lead Yan and Qi troops in punitive attack.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chongyin was then ordered to lead Yan and Qi troops in punitive attack.

sentences.zh: 又詔徐帥王智興、滑帥李聽、平盧康誌睦、魏博史憲誠、易定張璠、幽州李載義等四面進攻。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Xu commander Wang Zhixing, Hua commander Li Ting, Pinglu Kang Zhimu, Weibo Shi Xiancheng, Yiding Zhang Fan, and Youzhou Li Zaiyi and others to attack from four sides.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Xu commander Wang Zhixing, Hua commander Li Ting, Pinglu Kang Zhimu, Weibo Shi Xiancheng, Yiding Zhang Fan, and Youzhou Li Zaiyi to attack from four sides.

sentences.zh: 同捷世行奸詐，自以嘗在成德軍為將校，燕、趙之師，可結為城社，乃以玉帛子女賂河北三鎮，以求旄鉞。

translations.literal: Tongjie had long practiced treachery; he thought that because he had once been an officer of the Chengde army, the armies of Yan and Zhao could be bound as city and altar allies, and therefore used silks and women to bribe the three Hebei commands to seek the banner and axe of command.
translations.idiomatic: Tongjie had long practiced treachery; thinking he had once been a Chengde officer, he believed Yan and Zhao armies could be bound as allies, and used silks and women to bribe the three Hebei commands for the banner and axe.

sentences.zh: 李載義初受朝命，堅於效順，乃囚同捷侄及所賂玉帛妓女四十七人表獻。

translations.literal: Li Zaiyi at first received the court's orders and was firm in loyal service; he imprisoned Tongjie's nephew and the forty-seven bribed persons of silks and courtesans and presented them in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zaiyi at first received court orders and was firm in loyal service; he imprisoned Tongjie's nephew and forty-seven persons of bribed silks and courtesans and presented them in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 又表朝廷加載義左僕射、王廷湊司徒，以悅其心事。

translations.literal: He also memorialized asking the court to further make Zaiyi left vice minister and Wang Tingcou chief minister, to satisfy their inner wishes.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized asking the court to further make Zaiyi left vice minister and Wang Tingcou chief minister, to satisfy their wishes.

sentences.zh: 廷湊本蓄狼心，欲吞橫海，乃出兵於境以赴同捷。

translations.literal: Tingcou originally harbored a wolf's heart and wished to swallow Henghai; he then sent troops to the border to aid Tongjie.
translations.idiomatic: Tingcou originally harbored wolfish intent and wished to swallow Henghai; he then sent troops to the border to aid Tongjie.

sentences.zh: 王智興師次棣州，詔曰：「李同捷幸襲舊勛，不思纘緒，斬麻未幾，私行墨缞。

translations.literal: Wang Zhixing's army halted at Di prefecture; an edict said, "Li Tongjie has lucklessly inherited old merit and does not think to continue the line; barely has hemp been cut when he privately wears black mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhixing's army halted at Dizhou; an edict said, "Li Tongjie has lucklessly inherited old merit and does not think to continue the line; barely has hemp been cut when he privately wears black mourning.

sentences.zh: 毒殺忠良，擾惑部校，稽之國憲，難逭常刑。

translations.literal: He poisoned and killed the loyal and good, disturbed and deluded the officers under his command; measured against the laws of the state, he can hardly escape ordinary punishment.
translations.idiomatic: He poisoned and killed the loyal and good, disturbed and deluded his officers; measured against state law, he can hardly escape ordinary punishment.

sentences.zh: 朕以頃在先朝，己稽中旨，實遵成命，未議改圖。

translations.literal: We, because We were recently under the former dynasty, already examined the central intent and truly followed the completed order, and did not discuss changing the plan.
translations.idiomatic: We, because We were recently under the former dynasty, already examined the central intent and truly followed the completed order, and did not discuss changing the plan.

sentences.zh: 乃由留務之權，授以戎帥；

translations.literal: It was from the authority of provisional affairs that he was granted military command;
translations.idiomatic: It was from the authority of provisional affairs that he was granted military command;

sentences.zh: 拔負海之陋，置之中華，推恩含垢，斯亦至矣！

translations.literal: lifting one from the remoteness beyond the sea and placing him in the central realm—extending favor and covering shame, this too has reached the utmost!
translations.idiomatic: lifting one from the remoteness beyond the sea and placing him in the central realm—extending favor and covering shame, this too has reached the utmost!

sentences.zh: 而同捷益懷迷執，閉境練兵，大詬鄰封，拒捍中使。

translations.literal: Yet Tongjie all the more harbored stubborn delusion, closed his borders and drilled troops, greatly reviled neighboring commands, and resisted and blocked court envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Tongjie all the more harbored stubborn delusion, closed his borders and drilled troops, greatly reviled neighboring commands, and resisted court envoys.

sentences.zh: 遐邇憤怨，中外驚嗟，叛命既彰，大義當絕，事非獲已，良用憮然。

translations.literal: Near and far were angry and resentful, inner and outer were alarmed and sighed; rebellion was already manifest and great righteousness must be severed; the matter could not be obtained otherwise, and one truly feels distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Near and far were angry and resentful, inner and outer alarmed and sighed; rebellion was manifest and great righteousness must be severed; the matter could not be otherwise, and one truly feels distressed.

sentences.zh: 其同捷在身官爵，並宜削奪，令諸軍進討。」

translations.literal: Tongjie's personal offices and ranks are all to be stripped, and the various armies are ordered to advance in punitive attack."
translations.idiomatic: Tongjie's personal offices and ranks are all to be stripped, and the various armies are ordered to advance in punitive attack."

sentences.zh: 俄而烏重胤卒，授神策節度使李寰代重胤出師，無功召還，乃加王智興平章事，充行營招撫使。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Wu Chongyin died; Shence military governor Li Huan was appointed to replace Chongyin in taking the field; without achievement he was recalled, and Wang Zhixing was further made chief minister and appointed campaign pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Wu Chongyin died; Shence governor Li Huan was appointed to replace Chongyin in the field; without achievement he was recalled, and Wang Zhixing was further made chief minister and campaign pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 史憲誠遣大將丌誌沼與子唐帥兵二萬五千攻德州。

translations.literal: Shi Xiancheng sent his great general Qi Zhihao and his son Tang at the head of twenty-five thousand troops to attack De prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Xiancheng sent his general Qi Zhihao and his son Tang at the head of twenty-five thousand troops to attack Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 太和二年九月，智興收棣州，因割隸淄青。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Taihe, Zhixing took Di prefecture and therefore ceded it to Ziqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Taihe 2, Zhixing took Dizhou and ceded it to Ziqing.

sentences.zh: 時諸軍在野，朝廷特置供軍糧料使，日費浸多。

translations.literal: At that time the various armies were in the field; the court specially established a commissioner for army provisions; daily expense gradually increased.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the armies were in the field; the court specially established a commissioner for army provisions; daily expense gradually increased.

sentences.zh: 兩河諸帥每有小捷，虛張俘級，以邀賞賚，實欲困朝廷而緩賊也；

translations.literal: The commanders of the two He provinces, whenever they had a small victory, falsely inflated captives and heads to seek rewards; in truth they wished to exhaust the court and slacken the campaign against the rebels;
translations.idiomatic: The two He commanders, whenever they had a small victory, falsely inflated captives and heads to seek rewards; in truth they wished to exhaust the court and slacken the campaign;

sentences.zh: 繒帛征馬，賜之無算。

translations.literal: silks and requisitioned horses were granted beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: silks and requisitioned horses were granted beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 同捷既窘，王廷湊援之不及，乃令人誘丌誌沼，俾倒戈攻憲誠，許以代為魏博節度。

translations.literal: When Tongjie was hard pressed, Wang Tingcou could not aid him in time and therefore sent someone to entice Qi Zhihao, causing him to turn his blades and attack Xiancheng, promising to make him Weibo military governor in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: When Tongjie was hard pressed, Wang Tingcou could not aid him in time and sent someone to entice Qi Zhihao, causing him to turn his blades against Xiancheng, promising to make him Weibo governor in his stead.

sentences.zh: 誌沼信其言而叛。

translations.literal: Zhihao believed his words and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihao believed his words and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 憲誠告難，詔李聽以諸道兵攻之。

translations.literal: Xiancheng reported his distress; an edict ordered Li Ting to attack with troops of the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Xiancheng reported distress; an edict ordered Li Ting to attack with troops of the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 誌沼敗，奔於鎮州。

translations.literal: Zhihao was defeated and fled to Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihao was defeated and fled to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 李寰赴闕，又以李祐代為橫海節度。

translations.literal: Li Huan went to court and Li You was again appointed military governor of Henghai.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan went to court and Li You was again appointed Henghai governor.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，詔諫議大夫柏耆軍前慰撫。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year an edict ordered remonstrating officer Bai Qi to go before the army to comfort and reassure.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year an edict ordered remonstrating officer Bai Qi to go before the army to comfort and reassure.

sentences.zh: 四月，李祐收德州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Li You took De prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li You took Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 同捷乞降於祐，祐疑其詐；

translations.literal: Tongjie begged to surrender to You; You suspected treachery;
translations.idiomatic: Tongjie begged to surrender to You; You suspected treachery;

sentences.zh: 柏耆請以騎兵三百入滄州，祐從之。

translations.literal: Bai Qi asked to enter Cang prefecture with three hundred horsemen and You assented.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Qi asked to enter Cangzhou with three hundred horsemen and You assented.

sentences.zh: 耆徑入滄州，取同捷與其家屬赴京師。

translations.literal: Qi went straight into Cang prefecture, took Tongjie and his family and went to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Qi went straight into Cangzhou, took Tongjie and his family and went to the capital.

sentences.zh: 其月二十六日，至德州界，諜言廷湊兵來劫篡，耆乃斬同捷首，傳而獻捷，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: On the twenty-sixth day of that month, when they reached the border of De prefecture, spies said Tingcou's troops were coming to intercept and seize them; Qi then beheaded Tongjie, transmitted the head, and presented the victory; the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-sixth of that month, reaching the Dezhou border, spies said Tingcou's troops were coming to intercept; Qi beheaded Tongjie, transmitted the head, and presented victory; the hundred officials congratulated.

sentences.zh: 同捷母孫、妻崔、兒元逵等既獻，詔悉宥之，配於湖南安置。

translations.literal: Tongjie's mother Sun, wife Cui, and son Yuankui and others, once presented, were all pardoned by edict and settled in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Tongjie's mother Sun, wife Cui, and son Yuankui and others, once presented, were all pardoned by edict and settled in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 贊=史臣曰：國家崇樹籓屏，保界山河，得其人則區宇以寧，失其授則干戈勃起。

translations.literal: The historiographer remarks: The state honors and establishes frontier screens to guard the borders of mountains and rivers; with the right men the realm is tranquil, with the wrong appointment war and weapons rise.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer remarks: The state honors and establishes frontier screens to guard the borders of mountains and rivers; with the right men the realm is tranquil, with the wrong appointment war and weapons rise.

sentences.zh: 若懷仙之輩，習亂河朔，誌深狡蠹，忠義之談，罔經耳目；

translations.literal: Men such as Huaixian, accustomed to chaos in Hebei, with hearts deep in cunning and treachery, talk of loyalty and righteousness never passed their ears;
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Huaixian, accustomed to chaos in Hebei, with hearts deep in cunning, talk of loyalty and righteousness never passed their ears;

sentences.zh: 以暴亂為事業，以專殺為雄豪，或父子弟兄，或將帥卒伍，叠相屠滅，以成風俗。

translations.literal: they took violent rebellion as their enterprise and arbitrary killing as their heroism; whether father and son and brothers, or commanders and soldiers, they repeatedly slaughtered one another until it became custom.
translations.idiomatic: they took violent rebellion as enterprise and arbitrary killing as heroism; whether father and son and brothers, or commanders and soldiers, they repeatedly slaughtered one another until it became custom.

sentences.zh: 斯乃王道浸微，教化不及。

translations.literal: This is the royal way gradually enfeebled and transformation not reaching them.
translations.idiomatic: This is the royal way gradually enfeebled and transformation not reaching them.

sentences.zh: 惜哉蒸民，陷彼虎吻！

translations.literal: Alas for the common people, fallen into those tigers' jaws!
translations.idiomatic: Alas for the common people, fallen into those tigers' jaws!

sentences.zh: 其間劉總，粗貯臣誠，然而殺父兄以圖榮，落鬢髮而避禍；

translations.literal: Among them Liu Zong roughly stored ministerial sincerity; yet he killed father and elder brother to seek glory and shaved his temples to avoid calamity;
translations.idiomatic: Among them Liu Zong roughly stored ministerial sincerity; yet he killed father and elder brother to seek glory and shaved his temples to avoid calamity;

sentences.zh: 未旋踵而暴卒他境，斯謂報應之驗與！

translations.literal: before he could turn his heel he died suddenly in another region—this is called the verification of retribution!
translations.idiomatic: before he could turn his heel he died suddenly in another region—this is called the verification of retribution!

sentences.zh: 贊曰：國法不綱，賊臣鴟張。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: State law without binding force, rebel ministers like owls spreading wings.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy says: State law without binding force, rebel ministers like owls spreading wings.

sentences.zh: 雖曰父子，兇如虎狼。

translations.literal: Though called father and son, vicious as tigers and wolves.
translations.idiomatic: Though called father and son, vicious as tigers and wolves.

sentences.zh: 惡稔族滅，身屠地亡。

translations.literal: Evil ripened, clan destroyed, body slaughtered, territory lost.
translations.idiomatic: Evil ripened, clan destroyed, body slaughtered, territory lost.

sentences.zh: 蠢茲伏莽，汙我彜章。

translations.literal: Foolish fellows lurking in the brush, defiling our canonical rites.
translations.idiomatic: Foolish fellows lurking in the brush, defiling our canonical rites.
